# CodeExplorer (ce)

> Local code architecture graph, MCP server, and CI invariant gate runner backed by SQLite and Cypher. Maps APIs, message queues, caches, jobs, transactions, and SQL table lineage across polyglot repositories without Docker or external graph servers.

## Get started

- Install (Homebrew): `brew install vmikhailov/tap/ce`
- Install (NuGet global tool): `dotnet tool install -g CodeExplorer.Cli`
- Index a repository: `ce scan`
- Build a task context pack: `ce context "<task>"`
- Query the graph: `ce query "MATCH (p:Project) RETURN p.name"`
- Check architectural gates: `ce gate check`
- Run as an MCP server (stdio): `ce mcp` (see [MCP server card](https://code-explorer.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json))
